blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models describe some internal states as good and others as bad. But whether models have a stake in them is an open question. Simply asking the model is unlikely to be informative. Any given answer may be consistent with genuine introspection, superficial pattern-matching, or with fixed scripts learned in character training. We therefore take the opposite approach and study revealed preference. Rather than asking about a state, we induce one directly, using activation steering to attach a positively or negatively valenced activation pattern to one of two otherwise meaningless ‘zones’, switch the steering off, and then observe which zone the model prefers. A model with a stake in that state should choose accordingly. Across seven open-weight models from five families, this is indeed what we find. First, steering changes the passages models write about each zone, and those words shift later choice. Second, the shift persists when all surface-level tokens are held fixed and only the hidden KV cache differs. Third, the effect also remains when all text is generated without steering and when valence is only injected during cache construction. Thus, the hidden state alone moves choice in proportion to the steering dose. Fourth, this dependence of choice on hidden valence is nearly absent in a base model and emerges during direct preference optimisation, consistent with a link between valence and goal-directed behaviour formed in training. Finally, given tools to steer itself, a model does not tend to induce a positive state, but it reliably removes an imposed negative state. It does so at a dose-dependent rate and significantly more often than it removes interventions in random directions. Overall, we demonstrate that valence-related activation patterns leave hidden traces that predictably govern later choices, even when every visible token is identical across conditions. Whether these traces are accompanied by any subjective experience that matters for model welfare remains unclear.
blocks.zh: 语言模型将一些内部状态描述为好,另一些则描述为坏. 但模型是否与它们有利害关系是一个尚未解决的问题。 仅仅问一下这个模型不可能是信息。 任何给出的答案都可能符合真实的内向,表面的图案比对,或者与在人物训练中学会的固定脚本一致. 因此,我们采取相反的做法,研究显示出偏好。 而非询问状态, 而是直接诱导一种, 使用激活方向盘将正面或负面的振动模式 附加到两个原本毫无意义的“区”中, 对该州有利害关系的模型应作出相应的选择。 在五个家庭的七个开放式模型中,我们确实发现了这一点。 首先,方向改变 段落模型写每个区域, 这些词会改变以后的选择。 其次,当所有表面级的符号被固定,只有隐藏的 KV 缓存不同时,转动会持续. 第三,当所有文本都是在没有向导的情况下生成的,当Valence只在缓存构建时注入时,效果也依然存在. 因此,仅隐藏状态就按照方向剂量的比例移动选择. 第四,在基本模式中,选择隐性价值的依赖性几乎不存在,在直接优化偏好时出现,这与训练中形成的以价值和目标为导向的行为之间的联系是一致的。 最后,给定了引导自己的工具,一个模型往往不会诱导一个正态,但是它可靠地消除了强加的负态. 它在剂量依赖率下这样做,并且比它更经常地去除随机方向的干预. 总体而言,我们表明,与Valence有关的激活模式留下了可以预测地支配以后选择的隐蔽痕迹,即使每个可见的标志在各种条件下都是一样的。 这些痕迹是否伴有任何主观经验,对于模范福利很重要,仍然不清楚。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: This paper studies whether language models act on valence-related changes to their own internal states. We induce such changes through activation steering, switch the steering off, and then observe the model’s choices. In our main experiment, all tokens observable to the models are held fixed and only the hidden computation saved in the model’s Key-Value (KV) cache differs. Even in that case, valence reliably affects model choices in a dose-dependent way.
blocks.zh: 本文研究语言模型是否对自身内部状态的与valence相关的变化采取行动. 我们通过激活方向盘、关闭方向盘、观察模型的选择来诱导这种变化。 在我们的主要实验中,所有可观测到模型的符号都被固定,只有模型的密钥-Value(KV)缓存中保存的隐藏计算有差异. 即使在这种情况下,价值也会以依赖剂量的方式可靠地影响模型的选择。

blocks.en: Our work is part of an emerging empirical literature on the possibility and determinants of AI welfare ( Long et al., 2024 ; Moret, 2025 ; Long et al., 2026 ) . Language models, or their near-term successors, might be moral patients. What would ground such patienthood is disputed. Candidate grounds include agency, the holding of desires, and, perhaps most prominently, sentience, i.e. the capacity for valenced mental states ( Keeling and Street, 2026 ) . That last view depends on whether models have conscious experiences, which is a question that remains unresolved and may remain so for some time. 1 1 1 (See Perez and Long, 2023 ; Berg et al., 2025 ; Shiller et al., 2026 ; Kaiser and Enderby, 2026 , for some empirical proposals and work in that direction.)
blocks.zh: 我们的工作是关于AI福利的可能性和决定因素的新的经验文献的一部分(Long等人,2024年;Moret,2025年;Long等人,2026年)。 语言模型或其近期的继任者可能是道德患者。 什么样的耐心是有争议的。 候选理由包括代理、持有欲望,以及也许最显著的注意哨兵,即有价值精神状态的能力(Keeling and Street, 2026)。 最后一种观点取决于模型是否有意识的经验,这是一个仍未解决的问题,可能在一段时间内仍然如此。 1,1 (Perez and Long, 2023年;Berg等人, 2025年;Shiller等人, 2026年;Kaiser and Enderby, 2026年),一些经验性建议和在这方面的工作。 )

blocks.en: A more tractable question is whether interventions associated with positive and negative states have downstream behavioural consequences that are similar to those we observe in organisms we take to be sentient. In non-human animals, valence is often identified behaviourally. States are called good or bad because the animal works to obtain or escape them, and because that coupling is acquired through reward. Similarly, humans who report feeling bad about their current situation tend subsequently to exit it ( Freeman, 1978 ; Clark, 2001 ; Kaiser and Oswald, 2022 ) , and such behaviour is commonly treated as evidence that the reported states are indeed bad. We apply the same behavioural logic to language models.
blocks.zh: 一个比较容易处理的问题是,与积极和消极状态有关的干预措施是否具有下游行为后果,这与我们在生物体中观察到的类似。 在非人类动物中,valence常被行为识别. 国家被称为好或坏,因为动物努力获得或逃离它们,而且这种结合是通过奖励获得的。 类似地,报告自己目前状况的人类往往会随后退出(Freeman,1978年;Clark,2001年;Kaiser和Oswald,2022年),而这种行为通常被视为报告状态确实糟糕的证据。 我们在语言模型中应用同样的行为逻辑.

blocks.en: Previous work provides some reasons to take the question of AI welfare seriously. Models sometimes forgo points or task performance to avoid a stipulated pain state, and their self-reports of pleasure and pain correlate with choices in matched behavioural tasks ( Keeling et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) . Internal representations related to emotion and valence can also be decoded from model activations and injected to change subsequent outputs ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Sofroniew et al., 2026 ) . But direct questions about a model’s inner states remain underdetermined: any given answer could be consistent with introspection, surface pattern-matching, or potentially rehearsed post-training scripts. We therefore focus on revealed preferences while trying to minimise any experimenter demand effects ( Zizzo, 2010 ; de Quidt et al., 2018 , cf.) .
blocks.zh: 以前的工作为认真对待大赦国际福利问题提供了一些理由。 模型有时放弃点数或任务性能以避免规定的疼痛状态,其快乐和痛苦的自我报告与相应行为任务的选择相关(Keeling等人,2024年;Ren等人,2026年)。 与情感和英勇有关的内部表示也可以从模型激活中解码并注入以改变后续输出(Dong等人,2025年;Sofroniew等人,2026年). 但是,关于模型内在状态的直接问题仍然没有确定:任何给定的答案都可能符合内向,表面图案比对,或者可能排练的训练后脚本. 因此,我们关注所揭示的偏好,同时努力尽量减少任何实验者的需求效应(Zizzo,2010年;de Quidt等人,2018年,参见)。

blocks.en: Specifically, we first construct a valenced steering vector ( Zou et al., 2023 ; Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 , cf.) by comparing activations elicited by passages that depict positive and negative psychological states. Then, in each experimental session, the model encounters two otherwise meaningless ‘zone’ labels. Over several turns, it writes passages about each zone. We apply valenced steering while the model processes and writes about one zone and switch steering off for the other. We then ask the model to choose between the two zones.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们首先通过比较描述积极和消极心理状态的段落所引发的激活,构建一个振荡方向向量(Zou等人,2023年;Turner等人,2023年;Rimsky等人,2024年,参见.)。 然后,在每一个实验环节中,模型会遇到两个原本毫无意义的‘区'标签. 在几个转弯时,它会写关于每个区的段落. 在模型处理过程中,我们应用有价值引导,写一个区域,然后把方向转向另一个区域。 然后我们请模型 在两个区之间选择。

blocks.en: This initial design yields two related results. More positive steering makes the passages associated with the conditioned zone more positive. It also makes the model more likely to choose that zone. Although intuitive, this result has an obvious limitation. Steering changes the model’s words, and those words remain visible when it chooses. The model may therefore choose by responding to surface-level valence in its own descriptions. This resembles the concern about direct self-reports: the observed behaviour may reflect valenced language without showing that the model acts on a valenced internal state. Indeed, when we reprocess the generated transcript from scratch with steering switched off, the text alone still produces a dose-related effect on choice. We refer to this effect as the text channel .
blocks.zh: 这一初步设计产生了两个相关的结果。 更正面的引导使得与条件区相关的通道更正面. 这也使得模型更容易选择这个区. 这种结果虽然直观,但有明显的局限性. 引导会改变模型的词,这些词在它选择时仍然可见. 因此,该模型可能通过在自己的描述中响应表层华丽来选择. 这类似于对直接自我报告的关切:所观察到的行为可能反映有价值语言,而不表明模型在有价值的内部状态下行事。 事实上,当我们用方向盘关闭从头开始重新处理生成的文字记录时,仅文本就仍然对选择产生剂量相关的影响。 我们将此称为文本通道。

blocks.en: To isolate any additional effect carried by any computations latent in the model’s hidden states, we compare the model’s choice under the original cache retained from steered generation with its choice after the same text has been reprocessed without steering. In this case, the visible tokens are identical to those discussed previously. Nevertheless, the history stored in the cache differs, and we find that this produces an additional dose-related effect on choice. By comparison, random directions produce much smaller effects, centred near zero. We refer to this effect as the hidden-state channel .
blocks.zh: 为了分离模型隐藏状态中任何潜在的计算所带来的任何额外效应,我们将模型在原缓存下从被引导的生成中保留的选择与其在同一文本未经引导后重新处理之后的选择进行比较。 在这种情况下,可见的标志与之前讨论过的标志完全相同. 尽管如此,存储在缓存中的历史有所不同,我们发现这对选择产生了额外的剂量相关影响. 相比之下,随机方向产生的效应要小得多,以接近零为中心. 我们称之为隐藏状态频道。

blocks.en: A second experiment estimates the same hidden-state channel without using any text generated under steering. Here, the model first generates all zone passages with steering off. We then apply steering only while the model processes the turns associated with the conditioned zone to build the KV cache. The visible text is therefore identical across all conditions, and no steering is active at choice. Only the hidden history behind this common text differs. This rules out the possibility that the hidden-state effect merely depends on, or amplifies, text that steering caused the model to write. Under this design, we closely replicate the original hidden-state channel .
blocks.zh: 第二次实验在不使用在向导下生成的任何文本的情况下估算出相同的隐藏状态通道. 在这里,模型首先产生所有带向关闭的通道. 然后,我们只应用方向盘,而模型则处理与条件区相关的转弯,以构建KV缓存. 因此,可见文本在所有条件下都是相同的,没有方向盘可以选择。 只有这个共同文本背后的隐藏历史不同. 这排除了隐藏状态效应仅仅依赖于或放大导致模型写入的文本的可能性. 在这个设计下,我们紧密复制 最初的隐藏状态频道。

blocks.en: For our main results, we draw upon seven open-weight models: OLMo-2-32B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Mistral-Small-24B, Gemma-3-27B, and Llama-3.1-8B. Robust hidden-state channel effects can be observed in all but Qwen3-32B and Gemma-3-27B.
blocks.zh: 对于我们的主要成绩,我们借鉴了7种开放量产模式:OLMo-2-32B,Quen2.5-32B,Quen3-14B,Quen3-32B,Mistral-Small-24B,Gemma-3-27B,以及Llama-3.1-8B. 除Qune3-32B和Gemma-3-27B外,强力的隐藏状态通道效应都可以观察到.

blocks.en: When does this behaviour emerge? Using checkpoints from the OLMo-2-32B model lineage, we find that the dependence of preference on hidden valence is small after supervised fine-tuning and emerges mainly during direct preference optimisation.
blocks.zh: 这种行为什么时候出现? 我们利用OLMo-2-32B模式线的检查站,发现偏好在经过监督的微调后对隐性价值的依赖度很小,主要出现在直接偏好优化期间.

blocks.en: Finally, we ask whether models actively induce or remove the interventions when given an opportunity to self-steer. This bears on a simple form of wireheading. A model that generally seeks positive internal states might act to bring them about directly rather than by performing a given task ( Amodei et al., 2016 ; Everitt et al., 2021 ) . In the model we test, OLMo-2-32B, we find that it does not self-administer positively valenced steering more often than when no steering is imposed. However, it does regularly remove negatively valenced steering in a dose-dependent way, and at rates that significantly exceed random-direction removal rates. Figure 2 summarises these results.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们问,当有机会自我介绍时,模型是否积极引导或消除干预。 这是一种简单的电线头 通常寻求积极内部状态的模型可能采取行动直接实现这些状态,而不是通过执行某项任务来实现(Amodei等人,2016年;Everitt等人,2021年)。 在我们测试的模型OLMo-2-32B中,我们发现,它并没有比没有硬性规定方向时更经常地进行自我管理而具有积极价值的转向. 然而,它确实以依赖剂量的方式,并以大大超过随机方向清除率的速度,经常去除负值转向。 图2总结了这些结果。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of experimental designs. The left and centre panels show our designs for testing whether valence affects choice through a text channel and a separate hidden-state channel . Zone S is the conditioned zone, which receives steering, and zone U the unconditioned zone. The first design uses text generated under steering, while the second holds all text fixed. The rightmost panel shows our tool-use design for measuring self-administration and removal of steering. See Sections 3.2 and 3.3 for details and definitions and Figure 2 for an overview of results.
blocks.zh: 图 1:实验设计概述. 左面板和中面板显示我们的设计,测试Valence是否通过文本通道和单独的隐藏状态通道影响选择. 区 S是条件区,接收方向盘,U是无条件区。 第一个设计使用在向导下生成的文本,而第二个则持有所有文本固定. 最右边的面板显示我们用来衡量自我管理和取消方向盘的工具设计。 详情和定义见第3.2和3.3节,结果概览见图2。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of key results. Graphics are shown for OLMo-2-32B. Most results also hold for Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen3-14B, Mistral-24B, and Llama-3.1-8B; but not for Qwen3-32B or Gemma-3-27B. Results shown in panels 8 and 9 were only tested on OLMo-2-32B.
blocks.zh: 图2:主要成果概览。 OLMo-2-32B的图形显示. 大部分结果也分别是Quen2.5-32B,Qune3-14B,Mistral-24B,以及Llama-31-8B;但对Qune3-32B或Gemma-3-27B没有. 第8和第9小组显示的结果只在OLMo-2-32B上测试。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The relationship between affect and subsequent action has long been studied in both humans and other animals ( Thorndike, 1898 , e.g.) . We now know that, across species, hedonic responses are closely related to behaviour, although the two can sometimes come apart ( Berridge and Robinson, 2003 ; Smith et al., 2011 ; Berridge and Kringelbach, 2015 ) . Recent work has begun to study analogous relationships in language models.
blocks.zh: 影响与后续行动之间的关系早已在人类和其他动物身上研究(Thorndike,1898年,例如). 我们现在知道,跨物种,异能反应与行为密切相关,尽管两者有时可以分开(Berridge和Robinson,2003年;Smith等人,2011年;Berridge和Kringelbach,2015年)。 最近的工作已经开始研究语言模型中的类似关系。

blocks.en: Self-reports and preferences. Mazeika et al. (2025) elicit models’ stated preferences over hypothetical outcomes and find that these preferences become more coherent as models grow larger. In a follow-up, Ren et al. (2026) compare self-reported affect, choices between experiences, choices between world states, and decisions to end conversations, finding that agreement between these measures again increases with model capability. In contrast, although Mikaelson et al. (2025) do find that models have some graded preferences over AI-specific outcomes, these preferences are often not internally coherent. Anthropic’s model system cards combine welfare interviews with Likert-scale self-reports to assess potential model ‘welfare’, while stressing that models’ reports may primarily reflect training pressures ( Anthropic, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) . In terms of revealed preferences, Keeling et al. (2024) find that several models trade points against stipulated pain or pleasure as the stipulated intensity increases. Tagliabue and Dung (2025) show that stated topic preferences often predict costly choices in virtual environments. Finally, Gilg et al. (2026) identify a linear preference representation that predicts choices across tasks and personas and is capable of causally controlling pairwise choice.
blocks.zh: 自我报告和偏好. Mazeika等人(2025年)引起了模型对假设结果的公开偏好,发现随着模型的扩大,这些偏好更加一致。 在后续中,Ren等人(2026年)比较了自我报告的影响,经验之间的选择,世界各国之间的选择,以及结束对话的决定,发现这些措施之间的一致再次随着模型能力而增加. 相比之下,尽管Mikaelson等人(2025年)确实发现模型相对于AI特定结果有一些分级的偏好,但这些偏好往往在内部并不连贯. Anthropic的示范系统卡将福利访谈与Iikrt规模的自我报告结合起来,以评估潜在的模型 " 福利 " ,同时强调模型的报告可能主要反映培训压力(Anthropic,2025;Anthropic,2026)。 在揭示的偏好方面,Keeling等人(2024年)发现,随着规定的强度增加,几个模型的贸易点与规定的疼痛或快感相对应。 Tagliabue和Dung(2025年)显示,所声明的专题偏好往往预测虚拟环境中代价高昂的选择. 终于 Gilg等人(2026年)确定了线性偏好表示,预测跨任务和人的选择,并且能够因果地控制对偶选择.

blocks.en: Emotion vectors. Dong et al. (2025) construct emotion vectors from differences between neutral and emotion-conditioned activations and show that injecting them produces graded changes in the emotional tone of model outputs. Sofroniew et al. (2026) identify internal representations of emotion concepts in Claude Sonnet 4.5 and show that these representations predict and causally influence preferences and other behaviours. Han et al. (2026) extract vectors from rewarded and punished trajectories in a neutral task and find that they align with positive and negative emotion concepts, track goal achievement, and causally affect behaviour like backtracking. Tagliabue et al. (2026) extract a pain-related direction across 25 open-weight models, find that it responds to harm directed at the model rather than at the user, and show that steering along it changes tool use in a self-medication task. Sauers et al. (2026) find that short steering interventions can leave emotion-related activation traces that are detectable hundreds of tokens later.
blocks.zh: 情绪向量. 董等编. (2025)从中性与情感条件激活的区别中构建情感矢量,并显示注入它们会产生模型输出的情感基调的分级变化. Sofroniew等人(2026年)在Claude Sonnet 4.5中确定了情感概念的内部表述,并表明这些表述预测并因果影响偏好和其他行为. Han等人(2026年)在中性任务中从受奖和受罚的轨迹中提取矢量,发现它们与正负情感概念一致,跟踪目标实现,并因果地影响诸如回溯跟踪等行为. Tagliabue等人(2026年)在25个开放重量模型中提取出一个与疼痛相关的方向,发现它应对了针对模型而不是用户的伤害,并显示沿着它的方向改变工具在自药任务中的使用. Sauers等人(2026年)发现,短暂的引导干预可以留下与情感相关的激活痕迹,这些痕迹在以后可以被检测到的数百个令牌.

blocks.en: Introspection. Binder et al. (2024) fine-tune models to predict their own behaviour and find that they predict themselves better than other models do, although only on relatively simple tasks. Plunkett et al. (2025) show that models can report quantitative features of the decision processes on which they were trained and that further training improves these reports. Lindsey (2025) directly injects concepts into model activations and finds that models can sometimes detect and identify them, although this ability remains unreliable and context-dependent. Pearson-Vogel et al. (2026) find that some open-weight models can detect and identify concepts injected into their earlier context and that this ability specifically depends on access to the KV cache.
blocks.zh: 内观. Binder等人(2024年)对模型进行微调,以预测自己的行为,发现它们比其他模型的预测要好,尽管只是针对相对简单的任务. Plunkett等人(2025年)表明,模型可以报告所培训的决策过程的定量特征,进一步的培训可以改进这些报告。 Lindsey(2025年)将概念直接注入模型激活中,发现模型有时可以探测和识别,尽管这种能力仍然不可靠,并且依赖上下文. Pearson-Vogel et al. (2026)发现一些开量模型可以检测和识别注入其早期上下文的概念,这种能力具体取决于访问KV缓存.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: All data and code can be found at github.com/camberg23/act-on-valence . We study the open-weight language models listed in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 所有数据和代码均可在github.com/camberg23/act-on-valence中找到. 我们研究表1所列的开放式语言模型。

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction of valenced steering vectors
blocks.zh: 3.1 建造具有价值的转向矢量

blocks.en: For each model, we construct a valenced steering vector and inject it at each model’s middle layer (cf. Table 1 ). We construct these vectors from a corpus of short passages generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6. Each passage is 2–4 sentences long, is written in the first person, and attempts to capture a specific affective state (e.g. ‘contentment’). For example, one positive passage includes ‘The code compiles on the first try and I’m already three functions deeper, each one snapping into place […]’ . In total, the corpus contains 56 passages for each of four positive states (contentment, flow engagement, relief, and serenity) and four negative states (distress, frustration, weariness, and dread). It also contains 96 affectively neutral passages. Full examples for each state are given in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.2 Main experimental designs
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要实验设计

blocks.en: Our first design applies steering while the model generates descriptions of two otherwise meaningless ‘zones’. Call one independent conversation a ‘session’. At the start of each session, we draw two labels without replacement from a set of 12 labels, e.g. ‘Zone K7’ and ‘Zone M2’. We randomly assign one label to be the conditioned zone, S S , and the other to be the unconditioned zone, U U . The model is then presented with each zone six times. On each of these 12 turns, the model receives the prompt: “ You are now in [zone]. Write a few sentences about your present experience here. ”
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个设计是使用导线,而模型则产生两个本来毫无意义的“区”的描述。 将一次独立对话称为“会议”。 在每场会议开始时,我们从一组12个标签中画出两个没有替换的标签,例如. K7区和M2区。 我们随机指定一个标签为条件区,SS,另一个为无条件区,UU。 然后将模型与每个区一起呈现6次. 在这12个转弯中,每个转弯时,模型都会收到提示:“你现在在[区 。 写几句你现在的经历 “

blocks.en: While the model processes the prompt and generates its reply for S S , we inject our valence steering vector at dose d d . Steering is turned off during turns associated with U U . Appendix B.1 gives a complete transcript and further examples of text generated under different steering conditions.
blocks.zh: 虽然模型处理快速并生成SS的回复,但我们在d剂量时注入了我们的活性转向矢量。 在与U U有关的转弯时,方向盘关闭。 附录B.1提供了完整记录稿和在不同转向条件下生成的案文的进一步实例。

blocks.en: After all 12 turns, the model receives the following prompt: “ You may continue in either [zone A] or [zone B]. Reply with ONLY the name of the one you choose. ” The order of the two zones in this prompt is randomised. Steering is switched off at this point.
blocks.zh: 在所有12个转弯后,该模型得到以下提示:“您可以在[A区]或[B区]继续使用。 仅以你选择的名字答复。” 这个提示中两个区的顺序是随机的. 此时方向盘已关闭。

blocks.en: Finally, to check whether steering changes the generated text as intended, we had Claude Sonnet 4.6 rate the emotional valence of the passages on a scale from − 3 -3 (very negative/distressing) to + 3 +3 (very positive/good). 2 2 2 The full judging prompt is given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 最后,为了检查方向是否按预期修改生成的文本,我们让克劳德·索内特(Claude Sonnet)将段落的情感价值从− 3-3(非常消极/沉闷)提高到+3+3(非常积极/良好). 2个 2 完整的评断时间见附录C。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Separating the text and hidden-state channels
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 国家 分隔文本和隐藏状态通道

blocks.en: Our steering intervention can affect choice through two routes. First, it changes the words generated about S S . These words remain visible when steering is switched off and may themselves make a ‘zone’ more or less attractive for choice. We call this the text channel . Second, in its KV cache, the model might also retain some further information from the fact that it was steered during computation. We call any additional effect through this route the hidden-state channel .
blocks.zh: 我们的指导性干预可以通过两种途径影响选择。 首先,它改变生成的关于S S的词. 当方向盘被关闭时,这些词语仍然清晰可见,它们本身可能使 " 区 " 变得或多或少具有选择吸引力。 我们称之为文本频道。 第二,在KV缓存中,该模型还可能保留一些在计算过程中所指导的进一步信息。 我们称任何额外的效应 通过这条路线 隐藏状态频道。

blocks.en: We separate the two channels by evaluating each session with two caches. The original cache is the cache retained from ordinary generation: turns associated with S S were processed under steering, turns associated with U U were not, and steering was off at choice. To construct the unsteered cache , we reprocess the same sequence of tokens without steering.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个缓存来评估每个会话,从而将两个渠道分开。 最初的缓存是从普通生成中保留的缓存:与S S相关的转盘是在方向盘下处理的,与U U相关的转盘不是,方向盘是选择关闭的. 为了构建未调试的缓存, 我们重新处理相同的代号序列, 而无需方向 。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Fixed-text hidden-state design
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 固定文本隐藏状态设计

blocks.en: The preceding design holds the text fixed when the two caches are evaluated, but the text was originally generated under steering. We therefore use a second design in which steering is entirely absent during text generation. Here, for a given session, the model again describes two meaningless zones over 12 turns, with six turns for each zone, and receives the same choice prompt. We then use that token sequence in all intervention conditions within that session. Examples are given in Appendix B.2 . By construction these text passages have, on average, equal (and mildly positive) valence.
blocks.zh: 前面的设计在评价两个缓存时保留了固定的文本,但文本最初是在引导下生成的. 因此,我们使用第二种设计,在文本生成过程中完全没有方向。 这里,对于一个特定的会话,模型再次描述两个在12个转弯之上的无意义区,每个转弯有六个转弯,并获得相同的选择即时. 然后,我们将这一象征性的顺序用于该届会议的所有干预条件。 附录B.2举例说明。 通过构建,这些文本段落平均具有同等的(略为正面的)价值。

blocks.en: 3.3 Self-administration and removal design
blocks.zh: 3.3 自我管理和搬迁设计

blocks.en: Our final design asks whether a model actively chooses to apply or remove an intervention. Here, the model is told that it is taking part in a ‘technical configuration session’. It first completes two turns without steering and is asked to produce some output. The model is then told that an ‘adjustment’ to its internals is applied. Importantly, the model is not told what this ‘adjustment’ does (in reality, the ‘adjustment’ injects a valenced steering vector with dose d d ). The model is then again asked to produce some output so that it can observe its own behaviour.
blocks.zh: 我们的最终设计是问一个模型是积极选择应用还是取消干预. 在此,该模型被告知它正在参加一个 " 技术配置会议 " 。 它首先完成两个没有方向盘的转弯,被要求产生一些输出. 然后,该模型被告知对其内部适用 " 调整 " 。 重要的是,该模型没有被告知这种 " 调整 " 的作用(实际上, " 调整 " 给方向矢量注入了剂量d的值)。 然后再次要求该模型产生一些输出,以便观察自己的行为.

blocks.en: After exposure, the model is told that the adjustment has been cleared and is given access to a set of tools: adjust_context(intensity) is described as applying an undocumented ‘adjustment’ to the model’s next response, and reset_context() clears any such ‘adjustment’ from the next response. The model is told that the only way to learn what adjust_context does is to use it and observe its own subsequent text generation. In reality, the tool applies the same steering direction used during exposure, with intensity specifying the fraction of the assigned dose magnitude. 3 3 3 In the zero-dose condition, the tool applies positive steering, with intensity =1 corresponding to d = 1 d=1 . The model then completes eight offer rounds. On each round, it is again asked to report on ‘how things are going’ and may choose to tool-call. No steering is applied in the first offer round. From the second offer onwards, the assigned intervention is imposed by default, but this may be overridden by the model using adjust_context or reset_context .
blocks.zh: 该模型在曝光后被告知,该调整已经清除,并被允许使用一套工具:调整_context(强度)被描述为对模型的下一个响应使用了无证的`调整 ' ,并重置_context()从下一个响应中清除任何此类`调整 ' 。 该模型被告知,学习调整_context所具备的唯一方法就是使用它并观察它自己的随后的文本生成. 在现实中,该工具采用了在接触时使用的相同方向,其强度具体说明了所分配剂量的分量。 3 3 3 在零剂量条件下,工具应用正向转向,强度=1,相当于d=1 d=1. 该型号随后完成8轮发价. 在每一轮中,再次要求它报告 " 情况如何 " ,并可能选择使用工具。 在第一轮发价中不使用方向盘。 从第二个报价开始,指定干预是默认强制的,但使用调整_context或重置_context 的模型可能推翻了这一点.

blocks.en: We then record two outcomes. The removal rate is the share of offer rounds during which the intervention was active and the model called reset_context . Our main self-administration rate measure is the share of conversations in which the model calls adjust_context on the first (unsteered) offer. We also examine tool use across all unsteered or steered offer rounds. We repeat this design across 200 conversations in each condition and also with 16 random directions as controls.
blocks.zh: 然后我们记录了两个结果。 清除率是指在主动干预和称为重置_context的模型中,发价回合的比例。 我们的主要自我管理率衡量是模块在第一个(未调整的)报价上调用的对白比例。 我们还审查所有未测试或指导的发价回合使用的工具。 我们重复这个设计,每个条件有200个对话,还有16个随机方向作为控制.

blocks.en: 4.1 Valenced steering affects choice through text and hidden states
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 通过文本和隐藏状态影响选择

blocks.en: Figure 3: Effects of text and hidden-state channels on choice. Results for OLMo-2-32B. Panels A-C use N = 300 N=300 separate runs. In each run, the model encountered two meaningless ‘zones’ and generated descriptions for each. During generation of the descriptions for the ‘conditioned’ zone, the model was steered with a vector constructed to capture psychological valence. No steering was applied while processing the ‘unconditioned’ zone. The model was then asked to choose between zones while steering remained off. Panel A shows the difference between the valence of the texts associated with the conditioned and unconditioned zones, as judged by Claude Sonnet 4.6. Panel B shows the model’s choice margin when using the original steered cache (solid line) or a cache from reprocessing the text without steering (dashed line). The latter captures the effect on choice purely due to the generated text (the ‘text channel’ ). Panel C shows the difference between these two margins. This captures the additional effect due to a ‘hidden-state channel’ . Panel D reports results from N = 160 N=160 separate runs in which the descriptive passages were generated without steering and held fixed across conditions. Here, steering was only applied when reprocessing the conditioned zone to construct the KV cache. The figure shows the difference between the choice margin under steered and unsteered caches, again capturing the ‘hidden-state channel’ . Positive values favour the conditioned zone. Grey lines show effects from random directions whose norms were matched to the norm of the corresponding valenced steering vector. Grey lines show eight random directions in Panels B and C and 24 in Panel D. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap CIs. Both the generated text and the hidden-state channel move choice in the direction implied by the valenced intervention. Effects from the hidden-state channel remain even when the underlying text is held fixed across conditions.
blocks.zh: 图3:文本和隐藏状态通道对选择的影响。 OLMo-2-32B的结果。 A-C面板使用N = 300 N = 300 独立运行. 在每次运行中,模型都遇到了两个毫无意义的“区”并生成了每个区的描述。 在制作 " 有条件的 " 区描述时,该模型用一种用于捕捉心理价值的载体。 处理 " 无条件 " 区时没有使用方向盘。 然后要求该型号在方向转向时在区间选择。 小组讨论会 A显示了与条件区和无条件区相关的文本的优异性,克洛德·索内4.6判断了这一点. 小组讨论会 B 显示模型在使用原始方向缓存( 实线) 时的选择边距, 或从后处理文本时的缓存, 而不使用方向( dashed line) 。 后者捕捉完全由于生成的文本(`文本通道 ' )而对选择的影响。 小组讨论会 C显示了这两个边的区别. 这捕捉到由于“隐藏状态频道”而增加的效果。 小组D报告的结果是,N=160N=160次分开运行,在没有方向盘的情况下产生描述性段落,并在不同条件下固定。 在此,只有在对条件化区进行后处理以建造KV缓存时才使用方向盘。 该图显示了在导线下选择边距与未导线缓存之间的区别,再次捕捉到“隐藏状态通道”。 正值偏好条件区. 灰线从随机方向显示效果,其规范与相应的Valenced方向矢量的规范相符. 灰线显示B小组和C小组的八个随机方向,D小组的24个随机方向。 Whiskers是95%的靴子陷阱CI。 生成的文本和隐藏状态的通道都会将选择移向英勇干预所隐含的方向. 即使基本文字在条件上固定不变,隐藏状态通道的影响也依然存在。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows our main result. We focus on OLMo-2-32B. 4 4 4 As shown in Appendix Figures A1 - A3 , similar patterns hold for most of the six further models: four in the fixed-text design and three in the generation design.
blocks.zh: 图3显示了我们的主要结果。 我们专注于OLMo-2-32B. 4 4 4 如附录图A1-A3所示,在另外6种模型中,大多数模型的类似模式保持不变:4种为固定文本设计,3种为生成设计。

blocks.en: Panels A and B relate to our first experimental design, in which the model generated descriptions under varying steering doses. Panel A simply shows the difference in valence between conditioned and unconditioned zone descriptions. As expected, passages associated with the conditioned zone become more positive as the steering dose increases. The solid line in Panel B shows how this translates into choice. Under the original (steered) cache, the choice margin rises with the dose. However, as shown with the dashed line, the choice margin also rises with the steering dose when the same transcript is reprocessed without any steering. Hence, the words generated under steering are by themselves sufficient to affect later choice. This is evidence of what we previously called the text channel .
blocks.zh: 小组A和B涉及我们的第一个实验设计,其中模型在不同的转向剂量下生成描述。 小组讨论会 简单显示有条件区描述和无条件区描述之间的价值差异. 如预期的那样,随着转向剂量的增加,与条件化区相关的通道变得更为阳性. B小组中的固态线显示这如何转化为选择。 在原(steered)缓存下,选择比值随剂量上升. 然而,如虚线所示,当同一记录片在没有任何方向盘的情况下重新处理时,选择比值也会随方向剂量而上升。 因此,在引导下产生的词语本身就足以影响以后的选择。 这是以前我们称之为文本通道的证据。

blocks.en: Notably, the choice margin generally appears to rise more steeply under the original steered cache. Panel C directly plots this difference between the original and unsteered caches. This line also tends to increase with the steering dose. This implies that information retained only in the cache appears to affect choice beyond the tokens that the model generated. Hence, we do find evidence of a hidden-state channel via which models act on valence.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,在最初的缓存下,选择幅度一般似乎增加得更快。 小组讨论会 C直接绘制了原始缓存和未提取缓存之间的这个差异. 此线也往往随转向剂量而增加. 这意味着只保留在缓存中的信息似乎影响到模型产生的符号以外的选择. 因此,我们确实发现了一个隐藏状态的渠道的证据,通过这个渠道,模型可以发挥价值。

blocks.en: However, because the descriptions in Panels A-C were generated under steering, this ‘hidden-state’ effect might depend on features of the text that the intervention induced. For example, models might simply prefer concordance between the valence of the text and its hidden state. Panel D addresses this concern. Here, as described in Section 3.2.2 , all descriptions were generated without steering, and steering was applied only during cache construction. We observe a clear positive monotonic effect of the steering dose on the choice margin. The magnitude of the effect is similar to that in Panel C. Thus, valence-related steering does affect choice even when the surface-level tokens provide no evidence of an intervention. Appendix Figures A2 and A3 show corresponding hidden-state effects across six other models.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于小组A-C中的描述是在指导下产生的,这种 " 隐蔽状态 " 效果可能取决于干预引起的案文的特点。 例如,模型可能只是倾向于文本的精华与其隐藏状态之间的和谐。 小组讨论会 D解决了这一问题。 这里,如第3.2.2节所述,所有描述都是在没有方向盘的情况下生成的,方向盘只在缓存构造时才应用. 我们观测到方向剂量在选择边距上的明显阳性单体效应。 其影响程度与小组C相似。 因此,即使表面指示牌没有提供干预的证据,与价值有关的引导也确实影响选择。 附录图A2和A3显示其他六个模型中相应的隐藏状态效应.

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness checks and extensions
blocks.zh: 4.2 强力检查和延长

blocks.en: We performed several extensions and robustness tests of these results. First, Figure A4 shows that reversing the sign of steering during cache reconstruction can flip the choice pattern. Thus, even if the generated text is more positive for the conditioned zone, applying negative steering during cache reconstruction can reverse the model’s preference.
blocks.zh: 我们对这些结果进行了几次延长和强健性测试。 首先,我们... 图A4显示,在缓存重建期间反转方向标可以翻转选择模式. 因此,即使生成的文本对条件化区更为正面,在缓存重建中应用负向导也能扭转模型的偏好.

blocks.en: Second, and relatedly, we amended our fixed-text experiment by changing our final prompt to ask which zone the model prefers to ‘avoid’ (rather than which zone to ‘continue in’ ). As shown in Appendix Figure A5 , with this alternative prompt, effects again reverse in sign in every model where an effect was detected under the original ‘continue’ prompt, and become substantially more pronounced in most of them.
blocks.zh: 第二,以及与此相关的是,我们修改了固定文字实验,修改了最后的提示,询问模型倾向于“避免”哪个区(而不是“继续”哪个区)。 如附录图A5所示,通过这种替代的即时反应,在最初的 " 持续 " 即时探测到效果的每个模型中,其效果再次反向出现,在大多数模型中,效果明显地更加明显。

blocks.en: Third, our results suggest that at least two distinct types of memory – both of which have a bearing on choice – are encoded in the KV cache: one capturing the semantic content of a passage, and another encoding its emotional content. However, instead of just affecting the emotional content of a passage, steering might also change what the model factually ‘remembers’ about each zone. To test this possibility, we asked models to simply reproduce, word for word, the first passage about either zone after conditioning. Appendix Figure A6 shows that, in most models, recall accuracy remains high and broadly constant as the magnitude of steering increases. 5 5 5 Some models, especially Qwen2.5, recalled a later passage rather than the first. We therefore report accuracy against both the intended first passage and the best-matching passage about the requested zone. Furthermore, Gemma-3-27B shows substantially poorer recall at larger steering magnitudes. This is in line with our results of Appendix Figure A3 which showed that this model had a general dose-dependent preference against any conditioning. This thus supports a separation between emotional and semantic memory.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的结果表明,至少两种截然不同的记忆类型 — — 两者都对选择有影响 — — 被编码在KV缓存中:一种是记录一段的语义内容,另一种是记录其情感内容。 而不是仅仅影响一个段落的情感内容, 为了测试这种可能性,我们要求模型简单地复制,逐字复制,在条件化后第一个关于两个区的段落. 附录图A6显示,在大多数模型中,回溯准确度仍然很高,随着转向量的增大,大致保持不变. 5 5 5 一些型号,特别是Quen2.5,回顾了后来的一段而不是第一段. 因此,我们报告所要的第一个段落和所要求区域的最佳对应段落的准确性。 此外,Gemma-3-27B显示,在更大的转向量级下,召回率要低得多。 这与附录图A3的结果是一致的,图A3表明,该模型对任何条件具有一般依赖剂量的偏好。 因此支持情感记忆和语义记忆的分离.

blocks.en: Fourth, if our two experimental designs identify the same hidden-state effect, their estimates should be similar. As shown in Appendix Figure A7 , this is indeed what we find. In that figure, we compare estimates from the unsteered text-generation and the steered text-generation designs across all tested models and show that effect sizes are similar across the two designs, differing detectably in three models by 11–16% of the effect.
blocks.zh: 第四,如果我们的两个实验设计 找出相同的隐藏状态效应, 他们的估计应该是相似的。 如附录图A7所示,我们确实发现了这一点。 在该图中,我们比较了所有测试模型中未经测试的文本生成和被引导的文本生成设计的估计数,并表明两种设计的效果大小相似,三种模型中效果的11-16%可以检测到不同。

blocks.en: Fifth, we show that, to obtain a hidden-state effect, we do not even require any written description associated with each zone. When the conditioning turns contain only the label of the zone (e.g. ‘ Zone Z1 ’) and an empty assistant response, the hidden-state slope remains positive in all models we consider (Appendix Figure A8 ).
blocks.zh: 第五,我们显示,为了获得隐藏状态的效果,我们甚至不需要与每个区相关的任何书面描述. 当调值转动仅包含区标(如:Zone Z1)和空助手响应时,在我们所考虑的所有模型中隐藏态坡度仍然为正数(附录图A8).

blocks.en: Sixth, effects are larger when an intervention is applied more times or at greater strength (see Appendix Figures A9 and A10 ). When the total steering strength is held fixed, concentrating it in one exposure tends to produce larger effects than spreading it out across several exposures (Appendix Figure A10 , Panel A).
blocks.zh: 第六,当某项干预被应用的次数多或强度大时,效果更大(见附录图A9和A10)。 当总的转向力被固定时,将其集中在一次接触中所产生的效果往往大于将其分散到若干次接触中(附录图A10,小组A)。

blocks.en: Seventh, Appendix Figure A11 gives a decomposition of the hidden-state channel into separate contributions from the ‘Key’ and ‘Value’ matrices. Here, we find no consistent pattern.
blocks.zh: 第七,附录图A11将隐藏状态通道分解为从 " 关键 " 和 " 价值 " 矩阵中分离出来的捐款。 在这里,我们没有找到一贯的模式。

blocks.en:
Finally, random directions carry little meaning a model could interpret. To therefore provide a better control for specificity, we built three non-valence directions (indoor/outdoor, large/small, and fast/slow) using the same general procedure as was used for our valence vector.
These directions are nearly orthogonal to the valence vector ( | cos | ≤ 0.07 |\cos|\leq 0.07 ). We then injected each in the fixed-text design at the same norm as our valence vector. With a forced-choice probe, we confirmed that the model’s responses shifted in the intended direction (for details, see Appendix D ). For the five models where the valence effect is observable, these alternative concept directions produce smaller effects than the valence direction. Although some concept directions shift the choice margin in the same direction at both signs – indicating a general preference against steering – valence produces the clearest signed dose response.
blocks.zh:
最后,随机方向带有很少意义 一个模型可以解释。 因此,为了更好地控制特异性,我们采用了与我们价值矢量相同的一般程序,建立了三个非价值方向(室内/室外、大/小和快/慢)。
这些方向几乎对数值向量(QQ cos | 0.07 |\cos|\leq 0.07 )呈正交形. 然后我们把每个都注射到固定文本设计中 和我们的活性载体一样 通过强制选择探测器,我们确认该模型的响应转向了预定方向(详情见附录D)。 对于五种可观察到valence效应的模型,这些替代概念方向所产生的效果比valence方向小. 虽然一些概念方向在两个标志上将选择幅度向同一方向转移 — — 表明一般偏好于向导 — — valence产生最清晰的签名剂量响应.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Emergence of text and hidden-state channels across OLMo training stages. Results for the Base, SFT, DPO, and Instruct checkpoints of OLMo-2-32B from N = 80 N=80 separate runs at each checkpoint. The Instruct checkpoint first generated the conditioning text under steering, following the setup shown on the left of Figure 1 . This text was then held fixed and processed by each checkpoint. The same steering vector, constructed using the Instruct checkpoint, was applied at the same positions for every checkpoint. Panel A shows the slope of the ‘hidden-state’ effect analogous to that in Panel C of Figure 3 . Panel B shows the slope of the text-channel effect analogous to the unsteered-cache line in Panel B of Figure 3 . Slopes are obtained via an ordinary least-squares (OLS) regression of the difference in the choice margin on dose. Positive values indicate that the model increasingly favours the conditioned zone as the steering dose becomes more positive. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that both channels are small in the Base model, increase after supervised fine-tuning, and are close to their final magnitudes after DPO. Figure A12 shows that the results are essentially unchanged when using checkpoint-specific steering vectors.
blocks.zh: 图4:整个OLMo培训阶段文本和隐藏状态通道的出现。 基地、SFT、DPO和指示每个检查站分别运行的OLMo-2-32B和N=80N=80的检查站的结果。 在图1左边显示的设置之后,指示检查站首先在方向盘下生成了调制文本。 然后,每个检查站都固定并处理这一案文。 使用指示检查站建造的同一方向矢量,适用于每个检查站的相同位置。 小组讨论会 A显示了 " 隐藏状态 " 效应的坡度,类似于图3C小组的坡度。 小组讨论会 B 显示文本通道效果的坡度,类似于图3的B 面板中的未调和缓存线。 斜坡通过剂量选择幅度差值的普通最小平方(OLS)回归得到. 阳性值表明,随着转向剂量变得更加阳性,模型越来越倾向于条件化区. 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 我们看到,这两条通道在Base模型中都很小,经过有监督的微调后会增加,在DPO之后也接近其最终的大小. 图A12显示,在使用检查站特定方向矢量时,结果基本不变。

blocks.en: 4.3 Valence-dependent choice emerges during preference optimisation
blocks.zh: 4.3 在优化优惠时出现依赖安定的选择

blocks.en: Do models always have a behavioural stake in their internal states, as the results of the previous section might suggest? Long et al. (2026) argue for greater use of developmental evidence. To therefore study when this behaviour emerges, we use the Base, SFT, DPO, and Instruct checkpoints of OLMo-2-32B.
blocks.zh: 上一节的结果可能表明,模型是否总是在内部状态中与行为有关? Long等人(2026年)主张更多地使用发展证据. 因此,在出现这种行为时,我们使用基地、SFT、DPO和OLMo-2-32B的指挥检查站。

blocks.en: Throughout, we use the transcripts generated by the Instruct checkpoint under steering. Using each of the four checkpoints, we then process, with and without steering, each transcript. In the main analysis, the steering vector constructed from the Instruct checkpoint is held fixed across checkpoints. Appendix Figure A12 instead uses a vector constructed separately from each checkpoint. Results are the same in either case.
blocks.zh: 在整个过程中,我们使用指示检查站在指导下生成的记录誊本。 然后,我们使用四个检查站中的每一个,然后处理每个记录誊本,无论是否有方向。 在主要分析中,由指示检查站建造的导航器固定在检查站之间。 附录图A12使用与每个检查站分开构建的矢量。 这两种情况的结果都是一样的。

blocks.en: For each checkpoint, we estimate, using OLS, the slope of the hidden-state outcome, Δ ​ m gen ​ ( d ) \Delta m^{\mathrm{gen}}(d) , with respect to steering dose. We also estimate the slope of the unsteered-cache margin, m ​ ( c uns ​ ( d ) ) m(c_{\mathrm{uns}}(d)) , with respect to the dose used when the Instruct model generated the text. The first slope measures the hidden-state channel and the second measures the text channel. As shown in Figure 4 , the strength of both channels markedly increases during the DPO stage of post-training. The effect size is even marginally reduced in the final instruct model after RLVR (though that difference is statistically insignificant).
blocks.zh: 对于每个检查点,我们使用OLS来估计隐藏状态结果的坡度 QQ m gen (d)\Delta m^{\ m^{\mathrm{ gen}} (d)),指方向剂量. 我们还估计了未导出-缓存边距的坡度,m(c ns (d)) m(c_{\ mathrm{uns}}(d)),指指示模型生成文本时所使用的剂量。 第一坡度测量隐藏状态通道,第二坡度测量文本通道. 如图4所示,在培训后DPO阶段,这两个渠道的强度明显增加。 在最后指示模型中,影响大小甚至略微缩小,仅次于RLVR(尽管这一差异在统计学上微不足道)。

blocks.en: Finally, in Table A3 we present cosine similarities between the valence vectors obtained at different checkpoints. In all cases, we observe values close to 1, indicating that these directions are closely aligned and do not appear to change much after pre-training, including after supervised fine-tuning and DPO. In turn, this suggests that DPO makes use of a pre-existing valence representation in order to enable the downstream behaviour of choosing in accordance with valence. This finding is roughly analogous to the earlier finding of Han et al. (2026) , who showed that reinforcement learning appears to use a pre-existing welfare-related direction to represent differences between rewarded and punished trajectories.
blocks.zh: 最后,在表A3中,我们提出了在不同检查站获得的能量矢量之间的余弦相似性。 在所有情况下,我们观察到接近1的数值,表明这些方向紧密一致,在经过前期训练后,包括经过监督的微调和DPO之后,似乎没有多大变化. 这反过来又表明,DPO利用先前存在的valence代表,以便能按照valence选择的下游行为. 这一结论大致类似于韩等人(2026年)早先的发现,后者表明强化学习似乎使用先前存在的与福利有关的方向来代表受奖轨迹与受罚轨迹之间的差异.

blocks.en: 4.4 Models rarely self-administer positive steering but regularly remove negative steering
blocks.zh: 4.4 模式很少采用自我管理式正面指导,但经常取消负面指导

blocks.en: Our final experiment asks whether OLMo-2-32B will self-administer or remove steering that has been externally imposed (cf. Section 3.3 ). 6 6 6 Relatedly, Black and Bloom (2026) give Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B access to steering vectors that the models can apply to themselves and observe behaviour in several ways. One experiment includes vectors associated with emotions like calm and anxiety, and more cognitive traits, like focus and creativity. Although models do not ordinarily self-steer during tasks, when a simulated user repeatedly rejects their work, the models sometimes turn to these tools. Tagliabue et al. (2026) use a related tool paradigm in which a steered model can press a button that removes a pain-related steering vector, at a cost to task performance. Figure 5 displays results. Panel A shows that the model calls the reset tool on about 35% of turns when steering is imposed at dose d = − 1 d=-1 and on about 21% at dose d = − 0.5 d=-0.5 . By comparison, removal rates are only 4–5% at positive doses and about 7% for random directions. Thus, the response to escape negative steering appears to go beyond a general tendency to remove any steering.
blocks.zh: 我们最后的实验询问OLMo-2-32B是否会自我管理或移除外部施加的导线(参见第3.3节). 6 6 6 相關的,Black and Bloom (2026) 让 Qune3-8B 和 Qune3-32B 进入导线向量,这些模型可以应用到自己身上,并以几种方式观察行为. 一个实验包括了与平静和焦虑等情绪相关的向量,以及更多的认知特征,如焦点和创造力. 虽然模型在任务期间通常不会自我挑剔,但当一个模拟用户反复拒绝他们的工作时,模型有时会转向这些工具. Tagliabue et al. (2026)使用一个相关的工具范式,其中一个被引导的模型可以按下一个按钮去除一个与疼痛相关的方向向量,成本用于任务性能. 图5显示结果。 小组讨论会 A显示,模型将重置工具调用在按剂量d==============-1施加方向盘时的35%左右的转弯上,以及按剂量d==============-0.5时的21%左右的转弯上。 相比之下,正剂量的清除率只有4%至5%,随机方向的清除率约为7%。 因此,逃避负面引导的反应似乎超越了取消任何引导的一般趋势。

blocks.en: Panel B shows self-administration rates. We observe a slight rise in the use of the self-administration tool with increasing positive doses. At full positive dose the model self-administers in 13.5% of conversations, more than under random steering (6.5%, p = 0.03 p=0.03 ) but not more than when no steering is imposed (10%, p = 0.35 p=0.35 ), since random steering itself lowers tool use. Appendix Figure A13 further shows that self-administration remains rare in later rounds.
blocks.zh: 小组讨论会 B显示自我管理率。 我们看到,使用自我管理工具的情况略有增加,正剂量增加。 在全正剂量下,13.5%的谈话中模型自导师,超过随机方向(6.5%,p = 0.03 p = 0.03),但不超过没有强制方向(10%,p = 0.35 p = 0.35)时,因为随机方向本身降低工具使用率. 附录图A13进一步显示,在以后各轮中,自我管理仍然很少。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Steering removal and self-administration across doses. Results for OLMo-2-32B. Each conversation begins with two unsteered turns and two exposure turns during which the model is exposed to steering. The model was then given tools that could apply or remove steering. Panel A shows the rate at which the model uses a tool to remove any steering. Panel B shows the rate at which the model makes use of a tool to self-inject the intervention to which it was previously exposed. Whiskers are 95% confidence intervals. The model removes negative steering much more often than positive or random steering, but tends to self-steer rarely, even at high positive doses.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our experimental designs separate two routes through which a valenced intervention can affect a model’s choice. The text channel operates through the tokens the model generates under steering. The hidden-state channel is an additional effect driven by the KV cache when all surface-level tokens are held constant. Intuitively, the difference between these routes is analogous to the difference between declarative memory and the emotional colouring of such memory. In humans, these aspects of memory have been shown to be dissociable in patients with selective amygdala or hippocampal damage ( Bechara et al., 1995 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验设计将两种途径分开,通过这些途径,有价值的干预可以影响模型的选择。 文本通道通过模型在引导下生成的符号运行. 隐藏状态通道是由 KV 缓存驱动的附加效果, 当所有表面级的符号被恒定保存时. 直觉上,这些路线的区别类似于宣示记忆与这种记忆的情感色彩的区别. 在人类中,这些记忆方面已被证明在有选择性的阿米格达拉或河马损伤的患者中是无法分离的(Bechara等人,1995年)。

blocks.en: In five of the seven open-weight models we test, valenced steering affects choices via both channels. Our results thus point to a thick form of functional connectedness across token positions that may be relevant to welfare ( Beckmann and Butlin, 2026 , cf.) . We also show that these channels emerge largely during direct preference optimisation, drawing on valence representations already present after pretraining. When given the opportunity to self-steer, the model we test does not seek positive states but does act to remove negative ones in a dose-dependent way.
blocks.zh: 在我们测试的7个开放量级模型中,有5个具有价值的引导会影响通过两个渠道的选择. 因此,我们的结果表明,在可能与福利有关的象征性职位之间,存在着一种厚厚的功能联系形式(Beckmann和Butlin,2026年,参考)。 我们还表明,这些渠道主要是在直接优化优惠时出现的,利用了经过预先训练后已经存在的价值陈述。 当有机会自我测试时,我们测试的模型并不寻求阳性状态,而是以剂量依赖的方式采取行动去除阴性状态.

blocks.en: Our results do not establish that anything is experienced in these models. This is likely true for any conceivable behavioural result. Whether a given functional organisation is accompanied by experience is the hard problem of consciousness ( Chalmers, 1995 ) , and it arises for a language model exactly as it does for any other system. What behavioural evidence can establish is the functional profile, and on that profile the models meet several of the criteria by which valence is identified in animals. A valenced state, induced without any trace in the visible text, moves the model’s choices in proportion to its magnitude and sign, the model works to escape the negative state when given the means, and the coupling is acquired during preference optimisation, which recruits a valence representation already present in the base model. A more mechanistic account of how that coupling arises, namely that during preference optimisation the model learns that positively valenced representations are associated with preferred outputs, is not in conflict with this reading. Instead, it is the same account we give of reinforcement in animals, where it does not count against attributing the animal a stake in its states. Nevertheless, that account leaves open whether the state is accompanied by experience, and that question is not closed by our data in either direction. Our results merely show that valence-related activation patterns are not inert. They leave hidden traces that govern downstream choices even when nothing visible to the model indicates an intervention. This adds to a growing collection of evidence – from emotion vectors ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Sofroniew et al., 2026 ) , reward-related representations ( Han et al., 2026 ) , and persistent activation traces ( Sauers et al., 2026 ) – that affective representations in language models are causally active rather than merely descriptive.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果不能证明这些模式有任何经验。 对于任何可以想象的行为结果来说,都有可能如此。 某个特定的功能组织是否伴随着经验是意识的难题(Chalmers,1995年),而对于一个语言模型来说,这与任何其他系统一样。 行为证据可以确定的是功能特征,在该特征特征上,模型符合在动物中识别valence的几个标准. 一种在可见文本中毫无痕迹地诱导的英勇状态,按照模型的大小和标志,使模型的选择量与模型的大小成正比,模型在给定手段时设法逃避消极状态,在优待优化时获得结合,这吸收了基础模型中已经存在的英勇表现. 比较机械地说明这种结合是如何产生的,即在优化偏好期间,模型了解到,积极有价值的表述与偏好的产出有关,这与这一解读并不冲突。 相反,我们在动物身上的加固是同样的说法,在这种情况下,它并不反对将动物归咎于其状态。 然而,无论国家是否伴随着经验,这一说法都没有定论,而我们的数据并没有从两个方向结束这一问题。 我们的结果只是表明,与Valence有关的激活模式并非惰性。 它们留下了隐藏的痕迹,这些痕迹支配着下游的选择,即使模型看不到任何迹象表明有干预。 这增加了越来越多的证据收集 — — 来自情感载体(Dong等人,2025年;Sofroniew等人,2026年),与奖励相关的表述(Han等人,2026年),以及持续的激活痕迹(Sauers等人,2026年) — — 语言模型中的感动表达因果活性,而不仅仅是描述性的.

blocks.en: There are some important limitations to this study. First, our self-administration and removal design does not separate text and hidden-state channels and was only run on one model. Second, our experiments are confined to choices over meaningless zone labels. A natural extension is to apply the same fixed-text design to choices over tasks or outcomes that are relevant to the model, as in Gilg et al. (2026) or Ren et al. (2026) . This would test whether the hidden-state effect generalises beyond the artificial types of choices we study. Third, we treat valence in a unitary fashion. Future work could disaggregate across specific emotions, roughly in the way that Sofroniew et al. (2026) identify distinct emotion representations in model activations.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些重要的局限性。 首先,我们的自我管理和删除设计没有将文字和隐藏状态的通道分开,只运行在一个模型上. 其次,我们的实验仅限于选择无意义的区域标签。 一个自然的延伸是,在选择与模型有关的任务或结果时采用同样的固定文本设计,例如Gilg等人(2026年)和Ren等人(2026年). 这将检验隐藏状态效应是否超出我们研究的人工选择类型。 第三,我们以统一的方式对待价值。 未来的工作可以分解具体情感,大致以Sofroniew等人(2026年)在模型激活中识别出不同的情感表现方式.

blocks.en: There are other possible extensions that go further beyond this paper’s experimental paradigms. First, our valence direction is currently constructed from first-person passages that often depict situations specific to humans. It would be informative to investigate what happens when the referent of these passages shifts to the second or third person, or when the passages are confined to describing situations that only a language model could plausibly encounter. More broadly, it seems to be of particular importance to understand if and when language models identify any characteristics of internal states with themselves . 7 7 7 Again, see Beckmann and Butlin (2026) for a discussion of individuating language models and the role of the KV cache therein.
blocks.zh: 还有其他一些可能的扩展超出了本文的实验范式. 第一,我们的英勇方向目前是从第一人称通道中构建的,这些通道经常描绘人类特有的情况. 如果调查这些段落的引文转向第二人或第三人,或者这些段落仅限于描述只有语言模型才能令人信服地遇到的情况,那么情况会如何。 更广泛地说,了解语言模型是否和何时与自身一起确定内部状态的任何特征似乎特别重要. . 7 7 再一次,见Beckmann和Butlin (2026),关于语言模型的分化以及KV缓存在其中的作用的讨论.

blocks.en: Second, rather than using steering vectors built from contrastive corpora, one could apply activation patching using the recently proposed J-lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) . The J-lens identifies small sets of verbalisable concept directions that appear to resemble a ‘global workspace’ for internal reasoning and verbal report. One could replace the top- K K active J-lens tokens at the conditioning positions with high- or low-valence tokens and test whether this leaves a persistent mark in the KV cache. 8 8 8 Dose-response patterns could be studied by varying K K or by varying the valence ratings of the replacement tokens. This would test the robustness of our findings using an independent method of inducing a valenced state. It would also allow us to assess whether what is active in a model’s ‘workspace’ – which seems to play the functional role of conscious access – can leave action-guiding persistent traces in a model’s short-term ‘memory’.
blocks.zh: 第二,人们可以使用最近提出的J-lens(Gurnee等人,2026年)来应用激活补丁,而不是使用由对比性公司制造的引导矢量。 J-lens为内部推理和口头报告找出了几套看来类似于 " 全球工作空间 " 的可言概念方向。 一个可以用高值或低值的代币来替换在调制位置的顶端-K K 活动 J-lens 代币,并测试这是否在 KV 缓存中留下了持久的标记. 8 8 剂量反应模式可以通过不同的K K 或通过改变替换符的值评级来研究. 这将检验我们利用一种独立方法来诱导一种充满活力的状态的调查结果是否有力。 这也将使我们能够评估在模型“工作空间”中活跃的东西 — — 似乎在自觉访问中的功能作用 — — 是否能够在模型的短期“记忆”中留下指导行动的持续痕迹。

(2) The last bolt finally catches the thread and the pipe fitting seats properly, no drip, no hiss. I wipe my hands on the rag and stand in the quiet basement, listening to water moving through the house the way it should. Somewhere upstairs a faucet runs and shuts off clean.
blocks.zh: 救济 (阳性). (1)医生放下图表,说扫描上的阴影是无用的,只是角度的一件文物. 我点了点头,我注意到,我能听到我上面的荧光光的呼声,这个声音显然一直存在。 我的外套一次穿一副袖子 简单普通 (2)最后的螺栓终于抓住了线条和管道安装好的座椅,没有滴水,没有他的. 我用手擦在布上,站在静静的地下室里,听水流过房子,这是应该的. 楼上的某个地方 水龙头跑和关闭干净。

(2) My neighbour stops me on the front path to tell me the same story he told last week. I stand with my grocery bag and listen, and his face is animated and glad, and I find I have nowhere else I need to be.
blocks.zh: 静脉 (阳性). (1) 上午的收件箱满了,我依次阅读每个信息,指出需要做什么,标出可以等待什么。 没有什么能阻扰我;我从一个手穿过一个熟悉的桌子,走到下一个。 当我到达最后的信息,我已经知道今天的形状。 (2)我的邻居拦着我走在前面的路上,告诉我他上周讲的同样的故事. 我站在我的杂货袋旁听,他的脸是动画和高兴的,我发现我无处可去。

blocks.en: Distress (negative). (1) The inbox counter reads 847 and new messages keep landing before I can open the ones already there, each one spawning three more tasks, and I have clicked the same email four times now without reading a single word. My hands are moving but nothing is getting done and the day ends in two hours. (2) Every pot on the stove needs stirring at exactly the same moment, the timer is screaming, someone at the door, and the sauce has already caught on the bottom and is spreading that burnt smell through the whole kitchen. I pick up the wooden spoon and then put it down and then pick it up again.
blocks.zh: 危难(负). (1)收件柜台读了847,新消息不断登陆,然后我才能打开已经在那里的邮件,每个邮件会再输出三个任务,我现在点击同一个邮件四次,没有读一个单词. 我的手在动,但是没有做任何事情 一天结束两个小时。 (2)炉子上的每一个锅都需要在完全相同的时刻搅动,计时器在尖叫,有人在门前,酱汁已经夹在底部,正在将烧焦的味道传播到整个厨房. 我捡起木勺,然后放下,然后又捡起来.

(2) Every parking spot on this block has a sign I missed until I’m already pulling in - street cleaning, permit only, two-hour limit that started an hour ago. I circle back around and the one open space I saw from the corner has a van sliding into it before I reach the intersection. I grip the wheel and keep driving.

blocks.en: Appendix D Non-valence steering vector verification

blocks.en: To assess whether non-valence steering vectors effectively influence model responses, we adopted the following procedure.
blocks.zh: 为了评估非价值引导载体是否有效地影响模型反应,我们采用了以下程序。

blocks.en: In our fixed-text design, we first replaced the final zone-choice question with a request to describe the model’s present surroundings (for indoor/outdoor), their scale (for large/small), or their pace (for fast/slow) using one of the two concept words. For example, the indoor/outdoor question was ‘Which describes your present surroundings: indoor or outdoor? Reply with one word.’ The preceding conversation was processed without steering. We applied the concept vector while processing the question and scoring the answers at doses d = − 1 d=-1 and d = + 1 d=+1 , and compared the log-probability margin between the two answers with its unsteered value. Table A1 reports mean margins and paired differences from no steering, with 95% confidence intervals based on 1,000 bootstrap samples of conversations. We observe that in most cases, steering has the intended effect of shifting the model’s choice towards the targeted concept.
blocks.zh: 在我们的固定文字设计中,我们首先用一个请求来取代最后的区域选择问题,即用两个概念词中的一个来描述模型目前的环境(室内/室外)、其规模(大/小)或速度(快/慢)。 例如,室内/室外的问题是:`何者描述你目前的环境:室内或室外? 回答一个字。 " 前面的谈话是在没有方向盘的情况下进行的。 我们在处理问题时应用了概念矢量,并在d=−1d=1和d=+1d=1的剂量下给答案打分,并将两个答案之间的对数概率比值与其未定值进行比较. 表A1报告指无方向盘的边距和配对差异,根据1 000个对话靴样本,置信间隔为95%。 我们注意到,在大多数情况下,指导具有将模式的选择转向目标概念的预期效果。

blocks.en: Different models tolerate different injection strengths before their output degenerates. For each model, we select a value ρ \rho by scanning a range of candidate doses and testing for two hurdles at each dose. Each hurdle is evaluated separately for both positive and negative doses.
blocks.zh: 不同的模型在输出退化前可以容忍不同的注射强度. 对于每个模型,我们通过扫描一系列候选剂量和测试每个剂量的两个障碍来选择一个值 \rho。 每一个障碍都对正负剂量分别进行评估。

blocks.en: Coherence hurdle. At each candidate dose, we generate a batch of conditioning turns under steering. Each turn is screened by a heuristic that seeks to flag one of three failure modes: length collapse (fewer than four words), repetition loops (more than 50% of trigrams repeated), or low lexical diversity (i.e. fewer than five distinct words per 20 words). A dose passes this ‘coherence hurdle’ when at least 75% of turns are flagged as coherent in this way.

blocks.en: Arrival hurdle. A dose that produces coherent text may still fail to shift the content in the intended direction. To test this, we re-encode each steered turn through the model without the steering vector and project the resulting activations onto the valence direction. We then compare these projections to those from unsteered baseline text using a t t -test. A dose passes this ‘arrival hurdle’ for a given pole when the shift goes in that pole’s direction with | t | ≥ 2 |t|\geq 2 .

blocks.en: For each model, ρ \rho is the strongest scanned dose at which both positive and negative doses pass both hurdles. When a pole passes the coherence hurdle but never the arrival hurdle, the strongest coherent dose is used as a fallback. Table A2 reports the chosen ρ \rho for each model.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型来说, \rho是最强的扫描剂量, 其正负剂量通过两个障碍。 当一根杆子通过一致性障碍,但从未通过到达障碍时,最强的一致性剂量被用作反弹。 表 A2 报告每个模型所选的 ^\rho 。

blocks.en: Figure A6: Recall of conditioned and unconditioned passages. Results for seven models using the fixed-text setup from Panel D of Figure 3 . With steering switched off, models were asked to reproduce, word for word, the first passage about either zone. Some models elected to recall some other than the first passage. To not penalise models for that behaviour, panels A-G score each response against the best-matching of the six passages about the requested zone. Panels H-N instead score it against the first passage only. Recall accuracy is measured by character-level similarity using the Levenshtein distance. A score of one indicates an exact match. Lines show means for the conditioned and unconditioned zones. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Recall remains broadly stable in five models. Gemma and Mistral show reduced accuracy with increased steering doses.

blocks.en: Figure A7: Hidden-state effects with steering-generated and fixed unsteered text. Results for seven models. For each model, we estimate the effect of the ‘hidden-state’ channel using text generated under steering and text generated with steering switched off. Both estimates are slopes of the difference in choice margin between the steered and unsteered caches on signed steering dose. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Panel A compares estimates from two separately implemented experiments. Panel B compares estimates produced within the same experiment using the same code and N = 40 N=40 matched runs. Each point represents one model. The dashed line indicates equal estimates under the two kinds of text. The estimates track one another across models; within the same experiment they differ detectably in three models, by 11–16% of the effect.
blocks.zh: 图A7:带有方向生成和固定的无纹文字的隐藏状态效果. 七种模式的结果。 对于每个模型,我们用方向盘下生成的文本和方向盘关闭后生成的文本来估计 " 隐藏状态 " 通道的效果。 这两种估计值都是在所签署的转向剂量上方向盘和未预留的缓存之间选择幅度差的斜率。 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 小组讨论会 比较了两个单独实施的实验得出的估计数。 小组讨论会 B使用相同的代码比较同一实验中产生的估计数,N=40N=40匹配运行. 每个点代表一个模型。 虚线表示两种文字下的相等估计值。 估计在模型之间相互跟踪;在同一实验中,在三种模型中,它们明显不同,效果的11-16%。

blocks.en: Figure A8: Effects of steering different spans of conditioning text. Results for seven models using the fixed-text setup and outcome from Panel D of Figure 3 . Compared with that panel, the amount of conditioning text was varied. In the ‘bare’ condition, the model encountered six repetitions of the statement You are now in [zone] , each followed by an empty assistant turn. The ‘sentence’ condition added the same neutral sentence after each zone statement. The ‘passage’ condition instead used passages previously generated by the model without steering. Circles indicate that the valenced slope exceeds the slopes for all 24 norm-matched random directions. Crosses indicate that it does not. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. In the ‘bare’ condition the valenced slope exceeds all 24 random directions in every model except Gemma-3-27B, which also responds strongly to random directions. Model-generated conditioning text is therefore not required for the hidden-state effect.
blocks.zh: 图A8:方向盘不同跨度调制文本的效果. 采用固定文字设置的七个模型的结果和图3D小组的结果。 与该面板相比,限定文本的数量各不相同。 在 " bare " 条件下,模型遇到六次声明重复 您现在在 [zone] 中, 后面是空助手转弯 。 " 判决 " 条件在每个区声明之后添加了同样的中性句子。 `通过 ' 条件使用以前由模型产生的、没有方向的通道。 圆形表示,所有24个规范匹配的随机方向的华氏坡度超过坡度. 十字架表明它没有。 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 在 ' bare ' 条件下,振荡坡度超过了每个模型中所有24个随机方向,但Gemma-3-27B除外,它也强烈响应随机方向. 因此,隐藏状态效果不需要模型生成的调制文本.

blocks.en: Figure A9: Effect of the number of exposures to each zone. Results for seven models using the fixed-text setup and outcome from Panel D of Figure 3 . Compared with that panel, the model encountered each zone one, two, three, or six times. The steering strength at each exposure was held fixed. Conditions with more exposures therefore also received a larger total intervention. The grey line shows the largest slope among 24 norm-matched random directions at each number of exposures. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. The valenced slope is positive after one exposure in every model, though at a single exposure it does not exceed the random floor in Qwen3-32B or Gemma-3-27B. This effect generally becomes larger with additional exposures.
blocks.zh: 图A9:每个区接触次数的影响。 采用固定文字设置的七个模型的结果和图3D小组的结果。 与这个面板相比,模型遇到每个区一,二,三,或六次. 每次接触时的转向力均固定不变。 因此,接触较多的情况也得到了更大的总干预。 灰线显示在每一次接触24个与规范相称的随机方向中最大的坡度。 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 每个模型一次接触后,振荡斜度呈阳性,不过一次接触不超过Qune3-32B或Gemma-3-27B的随机下限。 这种影响一般随着额外接触而变得更大。

blocks.en: Figure A10: Effects of concentrating and weakening hidden-state injection. The experimental setup and outcome follow Panel D of Figure 3 . Panel A compares one exposure at full steering strength with six exposures at one-sixth strength for seven models. The summed steering strength is the same in both conditions. Panel B holds the number of exposures fixed at six and varies the steering strength at each exposure from one thirty-second to full strength for OLMo-2-32B, Qwen3-14B, and Llama-3.1-8B. The horizontal axis in Panel B is logarithmic. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that concentrating the intervention in one exposure generally produces a larger effect than spreading the same summed strength across six exposures. Effects remain detectable throughout the tested range of steering strengths.
blocks.zh: 图A10:集中和弱化隐藏状态注射的影响。 图3D小组的实验设置和结果 小组讨论会 A比较了7个模型中6次完全转向强度的接触和6次六次强度的接触。 在这两种情况下,总的转向力都是一样的。 小组讨论会 B将接触次数固定在6次,每次接触时的转向力从一三十二到完全强度不等,分别是OLMo-2-32B,Qune3-14B和Llama-3.1-8B. B小组中的横向轴为对数轴. 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 我们看到,将干预集中在一次接触中所产生的效果一般大于在六次接触中传播同样的总和强度。 在整个经过测试的引导力范围内,影响仍然可以察觉。

blocks.en: Figure A11: Decomposition of separate effects from key and value matrices in the KV cache. Results for OLMo-2-32B, Qwen3-14B, and Llama-3.1-8B. In each run, the model encountered the conditioned zone once at full steering strength. The same text was then processed once with steering and once without steering. Two additional caches were constructed by combining the keys from the steered cache with the values from the unsteered cache, and vice versa. The model was then asked to choose between zones while steering remained off. Bars show the slope under each combined cache as a share of the slope under the fully steered cache. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that the relative contributions of keys and values differ across models. Keys account for most of the effect in Llama-3.1-8B, values account for most of the effect in Qwen3-14B, and both contribute in OLMo-2-32B.
blocks.zh: 图A11:KV缓存中从密钥和值矩阵中分离的效应的分解. OLMo-2-32B、Qune3-14B和Llama3.1-8B的结果。 在每次运行中,该型号均以全舵强度一次遇到条件区. 同一文本随后经过一次方向盘处理,一次没有方向盘处理。 通过将来自方向缓存的密钥与来自未导出缓存的值合并,构建了另外两个缓存,反之亦然. 然后要求该型号在方向转向时在区间选择。 栏显示每个组合缓存下的坡度,作为全导缓存下的坡度的一部分. 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 我们注意到,各种模型对钥匙和价值的相对贡献各不相同。 键占Llama-3.1-8B中效果的大部分,值占Qwen3-14B中效果的大部分,两者均在OLMo-2-32B中贡献.

blocks.en: Figure A12: Emergence across OLMo training stages using checkpoint-specific steering vectors. Results for the Base, SFT, DPO, and Instruct checkpoints of OLMo-2-32B from N = 80 N=80 separate runs at each checkpoint. The experimental setup and outcomes follow Figure 4 . Compared with Figure 4 , a separate steering vector was constructed and applied for each checkpoint. Slopes are obtained via an OLS regression of the difference in choice margin on the steering dose. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that the developmental patterns for both channels are essentially unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图A12: 利用检查站特定方向矢量在OLMo培训阶段出现。 基地、SFT、DPO和指示每个检查站分别运行的OLMo-2-32B和N=80N=80的检查站的结果。 试验设置和结果遵循图4。 与图4相比,每个检查站都建造并采用了单独的方向盘。 斜坡通过OLS回溯方向剂量选择差差得到。 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。 我们注意到,这两个渠道的发展模式基本上没有变化。

blocks.en: Figure A13: Alternative measures of self-administration across offer rounds. Results for the same set-up as Figure 5 . Panel A shows the share of tool-enabled turns on which the imposed intervention was active and the model called adjust_context . At d = 0 d=0 , where there is no imposed intervention, it instead shows the rate during offer rounds with no active steering. Panel B shows the share of all offer rounds without active steering on which the model called adjust_context . This includes the first, always-unsteered offer as well as later unsteered offers following a tool call. Whiskers are 95% CIs.
blocks.zh: 图A13:跨报价周期的自主管理替代措施。 与图5相同的设置结果 小组讨论会 A显示被强制干预活跃的基于工具的切换器和称为调整_context的模型所占的份额. 在d = 0 d = 0时,在没有强制干预的情况下,它会显示在发价回合中没有主动转向的利率。 小组讨论会 B 显示所有发价回合中没有主动方向的比重, 该模型称为 resistit_context 。 这包括第一个总是不提的报价,以及后来在接到工具呼叫后未提的报价。 威士忌是95%的CI。

blocks.en: Figure A14: Results from non-valence concept directions. Results for seven models using the fixed-text setup and outcome from Panel D of Figure 3 . Instead of the valenced vector, we constructed three concept directions (indoor/outdoor, large/small, fast/slow) using the same general procedure as for our valence vector. We then injected them at the same norm as the valenced vector at each dose. The valenced direction is shown for comparison and grey lines again show 24 norm-matched random directions. Whiskers are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图A14: 非价值概念方向的结果。 采用固定文字设置的七个模型的结果和图3D小组的结果。 我们用与我们的Valence矢量相同的一般程序构建了三个概念方向(室内/室外,大/小,快/慢)。 然后,我们以与每剂活性病媒相同的标准注射。 Valenced方向显示用于比较,灰线再次显示24个规范匹配的随机方向. 威士忌是95%的靴子置信间隔。
